meta.name: content-research-writer
meta.description: 内容创作者、技术写作员在撰写博客、深度文章或技术文档时，使用此技能可开启全流程写作协作。它能帮你研究资料、构建大纲、逐段打磨并自动添加引用，快速优化Hook，让你高效产出高质量内容，告别孤军奋战！

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 产出带引用、逐段打磨的内容作品
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果写长文时总是卡在资料整理和打磨上
copy.tagline_en: Research, structure, and polish articles with citations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often get stuck on research and polishing when writing long articles.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会当你的写作搭档：和你一起搭大纲、查找资料并加上引用、优化开头 hook、逐段给反馈，最后整体润色，同时尽量保留你原本的写作风格。
howto.when: 当你写博客、文章、教程、技术文档等，需要研究资料、搭大纲或逐段打磨时，它会接管并进入写作协作流程。

say.text: 帮我为「AI 对产品管理的影响」这篇文章列个大纲
say.note: 它会先问受众、篇幅、写作目标

say.text: 研究一下这个主题，并给我的大纲加上引用
say.note: 它会找资料并按你选的格式列引用

say.text: 这是我写的开头，帮我把 hook 改得更有吸引力
say.note: 它会做分析并给几个备选开头

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude acts as a writing partner: it co-builds outlines, researches topics and adds citations, improves hooks, reviews each section, and polishes the final draft, while keeping your voice.
howto.when_en: Use it when writing blog posts, articles, tutorials, or technical docs and you want help researching, outlining, or refining the draft section by section.

say_en.text: Help me create an outline for an article about AI in product management
say_en.note: It first asks about audience, length, and goal

say_en.text: Research this topic and add citations to my outline
say_en.note: It finds sources and formats the references

say_en.text: Here's my introduction, help me make the hook more compelling
say_en.note: It analyzes it and offers several alternatives
